title: 建$10k/月的B2B SaaS Boilerplate
title_jp: 月収1万ドルのB2B SaaSボイラープレートを構築
title_ar: بناء قالب B2B SaaS بـ10 آلاف دولار شهريا
author: 阿星
content:
{"ops": [{"insert": "建$10k/月的B2B SaaS Boilerplate"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 1}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Alexandro Martinez是墨西哥瓜达拉哈拉的全栈SaaS创始人+开发者。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他成为创始人的很大原因是看到爸爸的生活方式。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他爸也是软件开发者，虽然从没推他进这行，但他一直 admire 爸爸怎么控制自己的时间。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "可以在家工作、陪家人、不被朝九晚五办公室 routine 绑住。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "如果需要出差，可以当天飞出去飞回来。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "那种灵活性真的很 inspire 他，他想要同样的自由。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他的职业生涯12年前开始，当时他帮爸爸把企业资源规划系统从旧技术（Informix 4GL，基于终端）迁移到更现代的 stack（.NET Windows Forms）。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "那项目教他很多关于建企业模块——开票、会计、库存管理等——至今还是他收入稳定的一部分。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "目前，他主要 focus 在SaasRock，他的React Router B2B SaaS boilerplate，帮开发者建多租户app。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "所有新定制开发项目都建在SaasRock之上。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这个付费boilerplate已经达到约1500用户，过去3.5年平均每月$10k+。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "建完之后，他还实验性推出了RockStack，Next.js和SvelteKit版本的boilerplate，瞄准更大市场。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但只有120销售，没能获得同样 traction，所以他 happily 回到React Router。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "灵活性刻进DNA"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": {"image": "https://storage.googleapis.com/indie-hackers.appspot.com/post-images/8QiT7aO4qYfwwbL5fvQJ/vOqaQ3DJwYRP8MNEjUOSMger71w1/alexandro-martinez-founder-of-saasrock.png"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "建SaasRock最初版本就是把从建ERP学到的 channel 进灵活的SaaS boilerplate。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "早期他意识到，在企业软件里，核心结构的很大一部分围绕："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "管理有对应细粒度权限的用户", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "分离 admin", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "账户/租户 dashboard", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "处理订阅 billing（循环、一次性、或基于用量）", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "设计成SaaS环境开箱即用", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他的主要技术栈围绕React/TypeScript："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "React Router v7", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "（以前叫Remix v1和v2）：对他来说最好的全栈web框架。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Tailwind CSS", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "：对设计的 granular 控制，同时保持一切一致、易定制。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "shadcn/ui", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "：如今设计系统基础标准之一。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Prisma", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "：主要配Postgres，但有时用SQL Server配 married with Microsoft/Azure的客户，或SQLite做快速MVP。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "部署", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "：通常部署在Fly.io，但有时用Vercel、DigitalOcean，甚至某些客户的专用服务器+静态IP。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "首选数据库通常是Postgres，要么自托管要么在AWS Lightsail，或需要托管方案时用Supabase。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "环境", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "：他在16" MacBook Pro + Cursor（Oscura主题）+ Claude Code CLI（Max计划）上编码。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "时机完美，他开始那年是Tailwind CSS真正起飞的一年。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他从没被Bootstrap或Material UI完全说服适合他自己的设计风格，但Tailwind really clicked。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "让他对建用户界面 excited。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他 still 有关于在Visual Studio里建Windows Forms的噩梦。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "规格驱动开发+Claude Code"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "今年他工作流的一个 major 改进是用Claude Code结合规格驱动开发方法。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这是他 follow 的流程："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "项目 context", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "：通过.md文件目录解释你的项目结构。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "功能构建", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "：让Claude规划功能，把PRD记在新.md文件里，比如FEATURE_CALENDARS.md。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "接受或拒绝改变", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "：测试功能。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "如果 work，用Git stage 你的改变；如果不，undo 并 iterate。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "更新文档", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "：让Claude用[x] checkmarks更新PRD已完成项，以及适用的项目 context 文件。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他为每个功能重复步骤1-4，以LLM友好的方式保持一切文档化，同时加速开发、保持清晰。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "混合模式"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "SaasRock用一次性许可定价模式："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "MVP版$249", "attributes": {"bold": true, "list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "：最实惠、精致、精简版", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "核心版$499", "attributes": {"bold": true, "list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "：加更多功能如表单构建器", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "专业版$1999", "attributes": {"bold": true, "list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "：包括widgets项目等高级工具", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他还通过MVP即服务提供定制SaaS开发："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "套餐从快速设置的$6k到完整3个月构建的$48k", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "大部分客户落在$10k-$16k/月范围", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "产品许可+定制开发的组合驱动稳定、可持续收入增长。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "内容、价值和声誉的混合"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这些年他用了很多策略："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "SEO", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "：早期他 heavy 投资内容，每次发布后写详细博客文章、维护公开changelog、积极更新的公开路线图。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "即使最终停了，努力 still 回报：SaasRock每月Google搜索约30k曝光。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "YouTube", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "：他开了频道，上传了约45个视频，涵盖SaaS开发、教程、幕后内容。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "大约七个月没发了，但人们 still 发现他的视频后 reach out。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "GitHub", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "：他创建并分享了很多围绕Remix/React Router的开源仓库。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这些项目提供 some value、让他的名声 out there。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "口碑", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "：他的定制开发客户很大一部分来自现有客户的推荐和推荐， complemented 他的MVP即服务页面，他在那里列SaaS开发服务。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "X", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "：他过去积极发推但 stopped，因为他不想听起来像卖SaaS梦的" snake oil salesman"。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他认为这种内容、开源价值、个人声誉的混合是SaasRock稳定增长的 foundation。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "显著建议"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他的建议："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "有韧性+耐心", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "：indie hacker梦经常看起来像你建个 side project、发布、立刻赚MRR或 hit 大退出。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现实中，你需要 put in 很多小时，或者对它们很有效。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "为 long game 准备自己。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "记住，当你 care 你解决的问题时 stay motivated 容易得多。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "坚持失败直到 something sticks", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "：听起来 cheesy，但 persistence 赢。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "每个"失败"都是向 finally clicks 的东西 progress。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Let go", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "：他 still 有"活着的死项目"，静静付$10/月域名/数据库/托管，只是因为他不想 shut down，即使没人用。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "那是"我有时间会改进/重塑/重新发布它"的永恒 promise。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "别过度工程", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "：经常，他发现自己在建没人要求的抽象。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这是他持续 work on 的东西，trying 简化、focus 在实际需要的东西上。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "像你在 hackathon 里一样建MVP。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "建一个 work 的可重用工作流。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "尽可能避免会议", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "（但为了建立信任而见面）：他的情况，和客户工作时，短的Loom视频比会议更有效：反馈、功能交付、问题。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "话虽如此，当你刚开始，看到你的脸帮助关系 start。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "小心 burnout", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "：对他来说，经常发生在他的期望增长比结果快的时候，即使那些结果其实 great。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "下一步"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "从这里，他计划："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "维护SaasRock", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "（低收入，长期）：继续改进他的boilerplate，focus 在B2B多租户解决方案。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "增长他的 Agency", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "（高收入，短期）：增长定制开发 agency 到每月最多管理五个客户。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一旦达到那 point，他会考虑雇个开发者帮他。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "建成功的SaaS", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "（高收入，长期）：他想 launch 一个 take off 的SaaS产品！"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他不再积极写博客文章、发推、或做视频了，但你可以加入他的Discord服务器开始公开讨论或直接私信他。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "**"}]}
content_en:
Building $10K/Month B2B SaaS Boilerplate

Alexandro Martinez is a full-stack SaaS founder + developer from Guadalajara, Mexico.

He became a founder largely because of seeing his father's lifestyle.

His father was also a software developer, though never pushed him into the field, but he always admired how his father controlled his own time.

Could work from home, be with family, not be tied to 9-to-5 office routine.

If needed to travel, could fly out and back the same day.

That kind of flexibility really inspired him, and he wanted the same freedom.

His career started 12 years ago, when he helped his father migrate an enterprise resource planning system from old technology (Informix 4GL, terminal-based) to a more modern stack (.NET Windows Forms).

That project taught him a lot about building enterprise modules—invoicing, accounting, inventory management, etc.—which still forms a stable part of his income.

Currently, he focuses mainly on SaasRock, his React Router B2B SaaS boilerplate, helping developers build multi-tenant apps.

All new custom development projects are built on top of SaasRock.

This paid boilerplate has reached about 1,500 users, averaging $10K+ monthly over the past 3.5 years.

他的职业生涯12年前开始,当时他帮爸爸把企业资源规划系统从旧技术(Informix 4GL,基于终端)迁移到更现代的堆栈(.NET Windows Forms)。

content_ar:
بناء قالب B2B SaaS بـ 10 آلاف دولار شهرياً

أليخاندرو مارتينيز هو مؤسس + مطور SaaS full-stack من غوادالاخارا، المكسيك.

أصبح مؤسساً إلى حد كبير بسبب رؤية نمط حياة والده.

كان والده أيضاً مطور برمجيات، على الرغم من أنه لم يدفعه أبداً إلى هذا المجال، لكنه دائماً أعجب بكيفية تحكم والده في وقته.

يمكنه العمل من المنزل، أن يكون مع العائلة، لا يكون مقيماً بروتين مكتب من تسعة إلى خمسة.

إذا احتاج للسفر، يمكنه الطيران ذهاباً وإياباً في نفس اليوم.

هذا النوع من المرونة ألهمه حقاً، وأريد نفس الحرية.

بدأت مسيرته المهنية منذ 12 سنة، عندما ساعد والده على ترحيل نظام تخطيط موارد المؤسسات من تقنية قديمة (Informix 4GL، قائمة على المحطة) إلى مجموعة أكثر حداثة (.NET نماذج ويندوز).

هذا المشروع علّمه كثيراً حول بناء الوحدات المؤسسية—الفواتير، المحاسبة، إدارة المخزون، وما إلى ذلك—والتي لا تزال تشكل جزءاً مستقراً من دخله.

حالياً، يركز بشكل رئيسي على SaasRock، قالب SaaS B2B الخاص به React Router،，帮助المطورينبناءتطبيقات متعددةالمستأجرين.

جميع مشاريع التطوير المخصصة الجديدة مبنية أعلى من SaasRock.

هذاالقالب المدفوعوصل إلى حوالي 1500 مستخدم، بمعدل 10 آلاف دولار+ شهرياً على مدى السنوات الثلاث والنصف الماضية.
